Because "AIO Code" can refer to a few different concepts depending on the context, here are the most likely possibilities:

1. Microsoft All-In-One Code Framework

Historically, AIO Code often refers to the Microsoft All-In-One Code Framework (sometimes codenamed CodeFx).   
Discover and Download BEST, FREE Software, Apps, and Games

What it was: A massive, free, centralized library of code samples created by Microsoft to help developers implement common programming tasks across various technologies (such as C#, VB.NET, C++, COM, and Azure).   
Microsoft Learn

Goal: Instead of hunting across disparate forums, developers could use these standardized, uniform packages within Visual Studio to see skeleton implementations of frequently requested features.

2. POSIX Asynchronous I/O (aio functions) in Programming

In system programming, developers often talk about AIO code when referring to Asynchronous Input/Output functions (like aio_read and aio_write).   
Guide to Realtime Programming

What it is: A programming interface that allows a process to initiate file or socket I/O operations that run in the background (asynchronously) without blocking the main execution thread.   
Guide to Realtime Programming

3. AI-Generated Code / Agentic Development Tools

With the rise of artificial intelligence, "AIO" is sometimes used colloquially as an abbreviation for AI-optimized or All-In-One AI development environments (such as containerized sandboxes that bundle VS Code servers, shell execution, and browser tools for AI coding agents).   
AIO Sandbox
